entry.title: No Goals, Just BIG Saves in OT 🚫

media:group.media:title: No Goals, Just BIG Saves in OT 🚫
media:group.media:description:
Overtime turned into a goalie showcase as the chances came fast and furious. Sidney Crosby nearly ends it after jumping on a loose puck in the offensive zone, but he's turned aside. Moments later, the action swings the other way and Matthew Knies gets a prime look on a 2-on-1, only to be denied as well. Back-to-back clutch saves keep the Penguins and Blue Jackets locked up in OT.
